$schema_note: MCP server manifest for ~/.claude. Registers servers used by the literature-check agent and DOI/citation lookups. Tokens NEVER inlined here — always file-referenced via env vars. Activate per-machine via `claude mcp add-json <server-name> '{...}'` referencing the entries below, or via `claude mcp add` interactively.

crossref.$source: github.com/h-lu/crossref-cite-mcp. Verified 2026-05-15. Set CROSSREF_MAILTO to your contact email for the polite pool (CrossRef gives higher rate limits to identified users).
crossref.$tools_note: Resolve DOI -> CSL-JSON / BibTeX / RIS / formatted text. Used for DOI validation (e.g. /hypothesis-new).
